study: WorldMOT v2 PWQT capacity and training-budget study
capacity_comparison: same frozen inputs, query slots, loss, sampler, optimizer, epoch budget and causal runtime; only width, depth and head count differ
selection_metric: same fixed start/middle/end 32-frame TRAIN-only cached identity-F1 surrogate as original study; not official MOT IDF1
epoch_selection: earliest large-model candidate within 0.002 absolute surrogate F1 of its best candidate; use this same epoch budget for both final profiles
threshold_selection: per-profile best registered threshold candidate at the common selected epoch
selected_weight_delivery_gate: unchanged continuous audit of all six complete TRAIN timelines, without adjusting thresholds; require nonzero assignments and persistent identities, retaining every scene

final_refit.scenes: all 24 TRAIN scenes and all 28754 timestamps each epoch
final_refit.initialization: fresh fixed-seed PWQT; no pilot or internal weights

gpu_policy: after original seven fits, one exclusive V100 queue slot runs capacity fitting while the other three run original complete-video comparisons; no shared-card jobs
precision: FP32 for both capacity profiles on V100
followup_TEST: freeze both profile configurations and all final weights before TEST; evaluate the four final trials on all 22 raw RGB videos and common original-GT-valid scenes, using the existing official protocol when original comparison cards become available
claim_limits: A larger network is not guaranteed to converge or improve tracking.
A fixed 24-epoch budget does not by itself establish convergence.
Differences from the original four-epoch model include training budget and learning-rate schedule; use the matched small control to assess capacity.
Only the large model has three final seeds in this extension; matched capacity differences use seed 20261022.
This is an independent WorldMOT study and does not import GMT model code.
